definition.description: Retrieves all orders for a customer from Microsoft Partner Center API. Returns a list of orders with line items, billing cycle, status, and transaction details.

inputFields.helpText: The unique identifier (GUID) of the customer in Partner Center.
Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

outputParameters.description: Total number of orders returned by the API
Number of orders in the items array
JSON array of all order objects
Total count of line items across all orders
JSON array of order statuses with counts
JSON array of billing cycles with counts (e.g., monthly, annual)
JSON array of transaction types with counts
ID of the most recent order
Creation date of the most recent order
Status of the most recent order
Billing cycle of the most recent order
The full raw JSON response body
HTTP status code from the API response
True if an error occurred during the request
Error details if the request failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when orders were successfully retrieved
Triggered when the request fails or returns an error status
